reference: Croom et al. 2021, MNRAS 505, 991 - the SAMI Galaxy Survey Data Release 3
extraction: SELECT * over the TAP table, VOTable saved byte-for-byte; TSV is a direct astropy Table -> pandas dump with no unit conversion, no cut, no join.
note: One row per SAMI data cube (repeats included).  ISBEST marks the preferred repeat; the WARN* columns are the DR3 quality flags.
